blocks.text: Ikkala zamon ham o'tmishda bo'lgan harakat haqida, o'zbekchaga ham ko'pincha bir xil tarjima qilinadi («-di», «-gan»). Ularning farqi — voqeaga **qayerdan qarayotganimizda**. **Present Perfect** — hozirdan qaraymiz: muhimi hozirgi natija, tajriba yoki hozirgacha davom etayotgan holat; vaqt aytilmaydi. **Past Simple** — o'tmishdagi aniq bir paytga qaytamiz: voqea o'sha yerda boshlanib, o'sha yerda tugagan. I**'ve lost** my keys — hozir kalitim yo'q. I **lost** my keys yesterday — kecha shunday voqea bo'ldi (balki keyin topgandirman ham).

rows: Tom **has lost** his key. — hozir ham yo'q
Tom **lost** his key yesterday. — kechagi voqea
I**'ve been** to Rome. — tajriba, vaqt aytilmagan
I **went** to Rome in 2019. — aniq vaqt
She**'s lived** here for ten years. — hali ham yashaydi
She **lived** there for ten years. — endi yashamaydi
The taxi **has arrived**. — hozir eshik oldida
The taxi **arrived** at eight. — soat sakkizda kelgan

blocks.text: Gapda **tugagan vaqt** bo'lsa — yesterday, last week, in 2019, three days ago, when I was a child, on Monday, at 8 o'clock — faqat **Past Simple** ishlatiladi. «I have seen him yesterday» — xato. Sababi mantiqiy: Present Perfect «hozir» bilan bog'liq (have — hozirgi zamon), yesterday esa butunlay o'tib ketgan vaqt — ular bir-biriga zid. Vaqt aytilmasa yoki u hali tugamagan bo'lsa (today, this week), Present Perfect mumkin.

rows: today, this week, this year (hali tugamagan)

blocks.text: When ...? va What time ...? — Past Simple

«Qachon?», «Soat nechada?» degan savol aniq o'tgan vaqtni so'raydi, shuning uchun u faqat Past Simple bilan beriladi: **When did** you **arrive**? «When have you arrived?» — xato. Savol Present Perfect bilan boshlanishi mumkin (**Have** you **finished**?), lekin «qachon» haqida so'ralishi bilan Past Simple ga o'tiladi (**When did** you **finish**?).
Suhbat: avval Present Perfect, keyin Past Simple

Ko'pincha suhbat yangilik yoki tajriba bilan boshlanadi (Present Perfect), keyin esa **o'sha voqeaning tafsilotlariga** o'tiladi — qayerda, qachon, qanday (Past Simple). Birinchi gap «hozir ahvol qanday» deydi, keyingilari o'tmishdagi aniq voqeani hikoya qiladi.

items.text: — I**'ve lost** my phone. — Oh no! Where **did** you **lose** it?
— I think I **left** it on the bus.

blocks.text: today, this week, this year kabi so'zlar bilan ikkala zamon ham mumkin — hammasi davr **tugagan-tugamaganiga** bog'liq. Davr hali davom etsa — Present Perfect, tugagan bo'lsa — Past Simple. Masalan, **this morning** haqida ertalab gapirsangiz — Present Perfect, tushdan keyin gapirsangiz (ertalab o'tib ketgan) — Past Simple.

rows: I**'ve had** three coffees this morning.
We**'ve had** two tests this week.

blocks.text: O'zbekcha gapda **vaqt** bor-yo'qligiga qarang. «**Kecha** kalitimni yo'qotdim» — tugagan vaqt bor → Past Simple. «Kalitimni yo'qotib qo'ydim» (hozir yo'q, vaqt yo'q) → Present Perfect. «-gan» ko'pincha tajriba (Londonda bo'lganman → I**'ve been** to London), lekin aniq yil yoki vaqt bilan kelsa — Past Simple: «2015-yilda turmush qurganmiz» → We **got** married in 2015. Hayotda bo'lmagan odamlar haqida ham — Past Simple: Navoiy ko'p she'r **yozgan** → Navoi **wrote** many poems.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I have seen him yesterday.» → I **saw** him yesterday.; «When have you arrived?» → When **did** you arrive?; «I have been to London in 2019.» → I **went** to London in 2019. (yoki vaqtsiz: I've been to London.); «I've finished school two years ago.» → I **finished** school two years ago.; «Shakespeare has written Hamlet.» → Shakespeare **wrote** Hamlet. (yozuvchi hayot emas, davr tugagan); «Did you finish? — Yes, I've finished it yesterday.» → Yes, I **finished** it yesterday.

Ikki qadamli tekshiruv: 1) Gapda **tugagan vaqt** bormi (yesterday, ago, last ..., in 2019, when ...)? Ha → **Past Simple**. 2) Yo'q bo'lsa — gap **hozirgi natija, tajriba yoki hozirgacha davom etayotgan holat** haqidami? Ha → **Present Perfect**.

Amerika ingliz tilida Present Perfect o'rniga ko'pincha Past Simple ham ishlatiladi (Did you eat yet? I just saw him). Bu kitob British English bo'yicha. Present Perfect ning barcha ma'nolari — 15–19-darslar, Past Simple — 11–12-darslar.

examples.title: I**'ve lost** my wallet / I **lost** it last week
examples.description: Juft gaplar: Present Perfect — hozirgi natija (vaqt aytilmaydi); Past Simple — o'tmishdagi voqea (vaqt aytilgan yoki ma'lum).

sentences.text: I**'ve lost** my wallet — can you lend me some money?
sentences.translation: Hamyonimni **yo'qotib qo'ydim** — menga ozgina qarz bera olasizmi?

sentences.text: I **lost** my wallet last week, but a kind man **found** it.
sentences.translation: O'tgan hafta hamyonimni **yo'qotdim**, lekin bir mehribon odam uni **topib berdi**.

sentences.text: Look! Somebody **has painted** our fence green.
sentences.translation: Qarang! Kimdir devorimizni yashilga **bo'yab qo'yibdi**.

sentences.text: My dad **painted** the fence two summers ago.
sentences.translation: Dadam devorni **ikki yoz oldin bo'yagan**.

sentences.text: Madina **has broken** her arm, so she can't write.
sentences.translation: Madina **qo'lini sindirib oldi**, shuning uchun yoza olmaydi.

sentences.text: Madina **broke** her arm when she was ten, but it's fine now.
sentences.translation: Madina **o'n yoshida qo'lini sindirgan**, lekin hozir hammasi joyida.

sentences.text: Tom **has gone** to Manchester. He's coming back on Friday.
sentences.translation: Tom **Manchesterga ketgan**. Juma kuni qaytadi.

sentences.text: Tom **went** to Manchester last month for a football match.
sentences.translation: Tom o'tgan oy futbol o'yini uchun **Manchesterga borgan**.

sentences.text: The price of the tickets **has gone** up, so we're not going.
sentences.translation: Chiptalar narxi **oshibdi**, shuning uchun bormaymiz.

sentences.text: Prices **went** up a lot in 2022, but they **were** stable last year.
sentences.translation: 2022-yilda narxlar **ancha oshdi**, o'tgan yili esa **barqaror bo'ldi**.

examples.title: yesterday, ago, in 2019 → Past Simple
examples.description: Tugagan vaqt aytilsa (yesterday, last ..., ... ago, in 2019, when I was ..., on Monday) — faqat Past Simple. Present Perfect + yesterday — xato.

sentences.text: I **saw** Aziz yesterday — he **looked** really well.
sentences.translation: Kecha Azizni **ko'rdim** — juda yaxshi **ko'rinardi**.

sentences.text: We **finished** school ten years ago.
sentences.translation: Biz maktabni **o'n yil oldin bitirganmiz**.

sentences.text: When I was a child, I **broke** my leg twice.
sentences.translation: **Bolaligimda** oyog'imni **ikki marta sindirganman**.

sentences.text: Emma **visited** Bukhara in 2019 and **loved** it.
sentences.translation: Emma 2019-yilda **Buxoroga borgan**, shahar unga juda **yoqqan**.

sentences.text: The meeting **started** at nine and **finished** at eleven.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish soat to'qqizda **boshlanib**, o'n birda **tugadi**.

sentences.text: Last night Bekzod **didn't sleep** at all.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechasi Bekzod **umuman uxlamadi**.

sentences.text: On Monday the boss **gave** us some bad news.
sentences.translation: Dushanba kuni boshliq bizga **yomon xabar berdi**.

sentences.text: My grandparents **got married** in 1965, in a small village near Fergana.
sentences.translation: Bobom bilan buvim 1965-yilda Farg'ona yaqinidagi kichik qishloqda **turmush qurishgan**.

sentences.text: A few minutes ago someone **knocked** on the door.
sentences.translation: **Bir necha daqiqa oldin** kimdir eshikni **taqillatdi**.

sentences.text: Shakespeare **wrote** Romeo and Juliet more than four hundred years ago.
sentences.translation: Shekspir «Romeo va Julyetta»ni **to'rt yuz yildan ko'proq vaqt oldin yozgan**.

examples.title: When **did** ...? (not When have ...?)
examples.description: «Qachon?», «Soat nechada?», «Qayerdan?» — aniq voqea haqida savol, shuning uchun Past Simple: When did you arrive? («When have you arrived?» — xato).

sentences.text: When **did** you **get** back from London? — On Saturday.
sentences.translation: Londondan **qachon qaytdingiz**? — Shanba kuni.

sentences.text: What time **did** the plane **land**? — At half past six.
sentences.translation: Samolyot **soat nechada qo'ndi**? — Olti yarimda.

sentences.text: **Have** you **finished** the report? — Yes. — When **did** you **finish** it?
sentences.translation: Hisobotni **tugatdingizmi**? — Ha. — **Qachon tugatdingiz**?

sentences.text: Aziz has a new phone. When **did** he **buy** it?
sentences.translation: Azizning yangi telefoni bor. Uni **qachon sotib oldi**?

sentences.text: When **did** your parents **move** to Tashkent?
sentences.translation: Ota-onangiz Toshkentga **qachon ko'chib kelgan**?

sentences.text: So the baby **has arrived**! When **was** she **born**?
sentences.translation: Demak, chaqaloq **dunyoga keldi**! U **qachon tug'ildi**?

sentences.text: Your jacket looks great! Where **did** you **buy** it?
sentences.translation: Kurtkangiz juda chiroyli! Uni **qayerdan oldingiz**?

sentences.text: Sarah **has left**. — Really? When **did** she **leave**?
sentences.translation: Sara **ketib qoldi**. — Rostdanmi? **Qachon ketdi**?

sentences.text: Excuse me, what time **did** the last train to Samarkand **go**?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, Samarqandga oxirgi poyezd **soat nechada ketdi**?

sentences.text: Tom **has been** to Japan. — Oh, when **did** he **go** there?
sentences.translation: Tom **Yaponiyada bo'lgan**. — Shundaymi, **qachon borgan**?

examples.title: News, then details: **has had** ... — **hit** ...
examples.description: Yangilik — Present Perfect; uning tafsilotlari (qachon, qayerda, qanday) — Past Simple.

sentences.text: Bekzod **has had** an accident. He **hit** a tree on the way to work.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **avariyaga uchrabdi**. Ishga ketayotib daraxtga **urilib ketibdi**.

sentences.text: Good news — Madina **has found** a job! She **started** on Monday.
sentences.translation: Xushxabar — Madina **ish topdi**! Dushanba kuni **ishga chiqdi**.

sentences.text: I**'ve cut** my hand. I **did** it while I was opening a tin.
sentences.translation: Qo'limni **kesib oldim**. Konserva ochayotganimda **kesib oldim**.

sentences.text: Our neighbours **have gone** to Turkey. They **left** early this morning.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarimiz **Turkiyaga ketishdi**. Bugun erta tongda **jo'nab ketishdi**.

sentences.text: Somebody **has stolen** Emma's bike! It **was** outside the library.
sentences.translation: Kimdir Emmaning velosipedini **o'g'irlab ketibdi**! U kutubxona oldida **turgan edi**.

sentences.text: Tom **has passed** his exam. He **got** the highest mark in the class.
sentences.translation: Tom imtihondan **o'tdi**. Sinfda **eng yuqori bahoni oldi**.

sentences.text: Have you heard? The old cinema **has closed**. It **closed** last Friday.
sentences.translation: Eshitdingizmi? Eski kinoteatr **yopilibdi**. O'tgan juma kuni **yopilgan**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **has broken** her new phone. She **dropped** it in the kitchen.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza yangi telefonini **sindirib qo'ydi**. Uni oshxonada **tushirib yuborgan**.

sentences.text: We**'ve bought** a new house! We **paid** for it with a bank loan.
sentences.translation: Biz yangi **uy sotib oldik**! Pulini bank krediti bilan **to'ladik**.

sentences.text: Grandma **has made** her famous cake. She **got** up at six to make it!
sentences.translation: Buvim mashhur tortini **pishiribdi**. Uni pishirish uchun oltida **turgan**!

examples.title: **Have** you **ever** ...? — When **did** you ...?
examples.description: Umuman tajriba — Present Perfect (vaqtsiz, 17-dars); o'sha tajribaning aniq bir voqeasi — Past Simple.

sentences.text: **Have** you **ever been** to Scotland? — Yes. I **went** there last year.
sentences.translation: Hech **Shotlandiyada bo'lganmisiz**? — Ha. O'tgan yili **borgandim**.

sentences.text: I**'ve eaten** horse meat only once. It **was** at a wedding in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Ot go'shtini **faqat bir marta yeganman**. Bu Samarqanddagi bir to'yda **bo'lgan**.

sentences.text: Madina **has been** on TV twice. The first time **was** in 2021.
sentences.translation: Madina **ikki marta televizorga chiqqan**. Birinchi marta 2021-yilda **bo'lgan**.

sentences.text: **Has** Bekzod **ever met** a celebrity? — Yes, he **met** a famous singer at the airport.
sentences.translation: Bekzod hech **mashhur odam bilan uchrashganmi**? — Ha, aeroportda bir mashhur qo'shiqchini **uchratgan**.

sentences.text: We**'ve seen** this play before. We **saw** it in London two years ago.
sentences.translation: Bu spektaklni **ilgari ko'rganmiz**. Uni ikki yil oldin Londonda **ko'rgandik**.

sentences.text: Tom **has never been** skiing, but his sister **went** to the Alps last winter.
sentences.translation: Tom **hech qachon chang'i uchmagan**, singlisi esa o'tgan qishda Alp tog'lariga **borgan**.

sentences.text: My father **has climbed** Chimgan many times. Last time he **took** me with him.
sentences.translation: Otam **Chimyonga ko'p marta chiqqan**. Oxirgi safar meni ham **olib borgan**.

sentences.text: Sarah, **have** you **tried** Uzbek bread? — Yes, I **had** some at breakfast this morning.
sentences.translation: Sara, **o'zbek nonini tatib ko'rganmisiz**? — Ha, bugun nonushtada **yedim**.

sentences.text: How many times **has** Aziz **failed** his driving test? — Twice. He **failed** again yesterday.
sentences.translation: Aziz haydovchilik imtihonidan **necha marta yiqilgan**? — Ikki marta. Kecha yana **yiqildi**.

sentences.text: I**'ve read** all her books, but I **didn't like** the last one.
sentences.translation: Uning hamma kitoblarini **o'qiganman**, lekin oxirgisi menga **yoqmadi**.

examples.title: today, this week (not finished) / yesterday (finished)
examples.description: Davr hali tugamagan bo'lsa (today, this week, this year) — Present Perfect; tugagan bo'lsa (yesterday, last week, ertalab o'tib ketgan bo'lsa this morning ham) — Past Simple.

sentences.text: I**'ve drunk** four cups of coffee today — that's too many!
sentences.translation: Bugun **to'rt piyola qahva ichdim** — bu juda ko'p!

sentences.text: Yesterday I **drank** only one cup, and I **felt** much better.
sentences.translation: Kecha atigi **bir piyola ichdim** va o'zimni ancha yaxshi **his qildim**.

sentences.text: Tom **has been** late three times this week.
sentences.translation: Tom bu hafta **uch marta kechikdi**.

sentences.text: Last week he **wasn't** late at all.
sentences.translation: O'tgan hafta u **bir marta ham kechikmadi**.

sentences.text: We**'ve had** a lot of rain this month.
sentences.translation: Bu oy **ko'p yomg'ir yog'di**.

sentences.text: Last month it **was** dry and sunny almost every day.
sentences.translation: O'tgan oy deyarli har kuni havo **quruq va quyoshli edi**.

sentences.text: Madina **has sold** twenty cakes this morning, and it's only eleven o'clock!
sentences.translation: Madina bugun ertalab **yigirmata tort sotdi**, soat esa endi o'n bir!

sentences.text: This morning I **missed** the bus, so I **was** late for work.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab **avtobusdan qolib ketdim**, shuning uchun ishga **kechikdim**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **hasn't called** me today. Is he OK?
sentences.translation: Bekzod bugun menga **qo'ng'iroq qilmadi**. U yaxshimi?

sentences.text: This year our company **has opened** three new shops, but last year it **opened** only one.
sentences.translation: Bu yil kompaniyamiz **uchta yangi do'kon ochdi**, o'tgan yili esa **bittasini ochgan edi**, xolos.

examples.title: **has lived** (still) / **lived** (finished): life stories
examples.description: Odam hali ham shu ishni qilsa yoki shu yerda bo'lsa — Present Perfect; davr tugagan bo'lsa (yoki odam hayot bo'lmasa) — Past Simple.

sentences.text: My grandfather **was** a doctor. He **worked** in Bukhara all his life.
sentences.translation: Bobom **shifokor bo'lgan**. Butun umri Buxoroda **ishlagan**.

sentences.text: My uncle **has been** a doctor for twenty years, and he still loves it.
sentences.translation: Amakim **yigirma yildan beri shifokor**, hali ham ishini yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: Charles Dickens **wrote** fifteen novels.
sentences.translation: Charlz Dikkens **o'n beshta roman yozgan**.

sentences.text: Our neighbour **has written** three books, and she's working on a fourth.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnimiz **uchta kitob yozgan**, hozir to'rtinchisi ustida ishlayapti.

sentences.text: Emma **taught** in Tashkent from 2015 to 2020, and then she went home to Oxford.
sentences.translation: Emma 2015-yildan 2020-yilgacha Toshkentda **dars bergan**, keyin uyiga — Oksfordga qaytgan.

sentences.text: James **has taught** in Tashkent since 2020, and he speaks good Uzbek now.
sentences.translation: Jeyms **2020-yildan beri** Toshkentda **dars beradi**, endi o'zbekchani yaxshi gapiradi.

sentences.text: Ibn Sina **lived** in Bukhara more than a thousand years ago.
sentences.translation: Ibn Sino **ming yildan ko'proq vaqt oldin** Buxoroda **yashagan**.

sentences.text: Aziz **has lived** in the same street since he was born.
sentences.translation: Aziz tug'ilganidan beri **bitta ko'chada yashaydi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **played** volleyball for her school, but she **stopped** when she went to university.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza maktab jamoasida **voleybol o'ynagan**, lekin universitetga kirgach **tashlagan**.

sentences.text: Her brother **has played** for the national team three times, and he's only nineteen!
sentences.translation: Uning akasi **terma jamoa safida uch marta o'ynagan**, u esa endi o'n to'qqiz yoshda!

examples.title: Dialogue: I**'ve lost** my phone!
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: suhbat Present Perfect (yangilik) bilan boshlanadi va Past Simple (tafsilotlar) bilan davom etadi.

sentences.text: — Oh no, I**'ve lost** my phone!
sentences.translation: — Voy, telefonimni **yo'qotib qo'ydim**!

sentences.text: — Again? When **did** you last **have** it?
sentences.translation: — Yana-ya? Oxirgi marta **qachon qo'lingda edi**?

sentences.text: — I **used** it on the bus this morning. I **called** my mum.
sentences.translation: — Bugun ertalab avtobusda **ishlatgandim**. Oyimga **qo'ng'iroq qildim**.

sentences.text: — **Have** you **called** the bus company?
sentences.translation: — Avtobus kompaniyasiga **qo'ng'iroq qildingmi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, I **phoned** them an hour ago, but nobody **has found** it.
sentences.translation: — Ha, bir soat oldin **qo'ng'iroq qildim**, lekin hech kim uni **topmabdi**.

sentences.text: — **Have** you **checked** your coat pockets?
sentences.translation: — Paltoning cho'ntaklarini **tekshirdingmi**?

sentences.text: — I **checked** them twice when I **got** to the office.
sentences.translation: — Ofisga **kelganimda** ikki marta **tekshirdim**.

sentences.text: — Wait... What's that on your desk? **Has** somebody **brought** it back?
sentences.translation: — To'xta... Stolingdagi nima? Kimdir uni **olib kelib qo'ydimi**?

sentences.text: — That's it! Sarah **found** it on the bus and **brought** it here an hour ago!
sentences.translation: — Xuddi o'sha! Sara uni avtobusda **topibdi** va bir soat oldin bu yerga **olib kelibdi**!

sentences.text: — Lucky you! This is the third time you**'ve lost** it this year.
sentences.translation: — Omading bor ekan! Bu yil uni **uchinchi marta yo'qotyapsan**.
